headline: New high school traffic and parking plan, Varieur Elementary HVAC update, and City Year contract approval.
summary: The meeting covers the new Pawtucket High School traffic and parking plan, Varieur Elementary HVAC work, and teaching assistant vacancies and training. It also includes contract items, including the City Year contract, and a possible closed session on a grievance and an employee's job performance.
